rights.fileTitle: File:Fossil Fuel Divestment Student Protest at Tufts University.jpg

photo.fileTitle: File:Fossil Fuel Divestment Student Protest at Tufts University.jpg
photo.caption: Students at Tufts University "marched forth on March 4th"
photo.description: Students at Tufts University "marched forth on March 4th" coinciding with dozens of student-led rallies around the United States. The marches had the objective of pressuring universities to reduce and eventually eliminate investments in fossil-fuel related ventures. Organized nationally through WeArePowerShift.org, these rallies included speeches, singing, and chanting of slogans such as "Divestment is a Tactic; Justice is the Goal."
